status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: List available subscription plans
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can view all available plans with pricing, limits, and features before subscribing.
verification: Call GET /api/v1/plans.
Verify response contains all active plans.
Verify each plan includes name, monthlyPrice, yearlyPrice, maxChatbots, maxStorageMb, maxMonthlyTokens, and features list.
Verify inactive plans are excluded from the response.

features.title: Get detail of a subscription plan
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can view full details of a specific plan including all feature keys and values.
verification: Call GET /api/v1/plans/:planId.
Verify response includes plan metadata and full features list.
Call with an invalid planId and verify 404 is returned.

features.title: Subscribe to a plan
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can subscribe to a plan by selecting a billing cycle. An order and invoice are created, and the subscription becomes active after payment.
verification: Call POST /api/v1/subscriptions with a valid planId and billingCycle.
Verify a Subscription record is created with status PENDING.
Verify an Order record is created with orderType NEW_SUBSCRIPTION.
Verify an Invoice record is created linked to the order.
Verify the subscription status changes to ACTIVE after payment is confirmed.
Verify startDate, endDate, currentPeriodStart, and currentPeriodEnd are set correctly.
Call again while an active subscription exists and verify 409 is returned.

features.title: Get current subscription
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can view their active subscription including plan details, period dates, and current usage.
verification: Call GET /api/v1/subscriptions/me with a valid JWT.
Verify response includes subscription status, plan info, currentPeriodStart, currentPeriodEnd, and autoRenew.
Verify usage summary for the current month is included.
Call without a subscription and verify 404 is returned.

features.title: Cancel subscription
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can cancel their subscription. It remains active until the end of the current billing period, then expires.
verification: Call DELETE /api/v1/subscriptions/me on an active subscription.
Verify subscription status changes to CANCELLED.
Verify cancelledAt is set to current timestamp.
Verify autoRenew is set to false.
Verify the subscription remains accessible and usable until currentPeriodEnd.
Call on an already cancelled subscription and verify 409 is returned.

features.title: Upgrade subscription plan
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can upgrade to a higher plan. The new plan takes effect immediately and a prorated order is created.
verification: Call POST /api/v1/subscriptions/upgrade with a higher planId.
Verify a new Order is created with orderType UPGRADE.
Verify the subscription plan is updated immediately.
Verify previousPlan is recorded on the subscription.
Attempt to upgrade to the same or lower plan and verify 400 is returned.

features.title: Toggle auto-renew
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can enable or disable automatic renewal of their subscription.
verification: Call PATCH /api/v1/subscriptions/me/auto-renew with autoRenew: false.
Verify subscription autoRenew is updated to false.
Call again with autoRenew: true and verify it is updated back to true.

features.title: List orders
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can view their order history including new subscriptions, renewals, and upgrades.
verification: Call GET /api/v1/orders.
Verify response contains all orders for the current user.
Verify each order includes orderNumber, amount, currency, billingCycle, status, orderType, and plan info.
Verify orders are sorted by createdAt descending.

features.title: Get order detail
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can view the full detail of a specific order including its linked invoice.
verification: Call GET /api/v1/orders/:orderId.
Verify response includes order info and linked invoice.
Call with another user's orderId and verify 404 is returned.

features.title: List invoices
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can view all their invoices with payment status.
verification: Call GET /api/v1/invoices.
Verify response includes all invoices for the current user.
Verify each invoice includes invoiceNumber, amount, currency, status, issuedAt, paidAt, and paymentMethod.
Verify invoices are sorted by issuedAt descending.

features.title: Get invoice detail
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can view a specific invoice and its linked order.
verification: Call GET /api/v1/invoices/:invoiceId.
Verify response includes invoice detail and linked order summary.
Call with another user's invoiceId and verify 404 is returned.

features.title: Mark invoice as paid (internal)
features.user_visible_behavior: After payment gateway confirms payment, the invoice status updates to PAID and the subscription activates.
verification: Call POST /internal/invoices/:invoiceId/confirm-payment with payment reference.
Verify invoice status changes to PAID.
Verify paidAt is set to current timestamp.
Verify paymentReference is saved.
Verify linked subscription status changes to ACTIVE.
Verify UsageSummary record is created for the current month.

features.title: Record a usage event
features.user_visible_behavior: Internal services (Chat, Ingestion, Core) can report usage events which are stored as usage records and reflected in the monthly summary.
verification: Call POST /internal/usage/record with userId, subscriptionId, botId, usageType TOKEN_USED, and quantity.
Verify a UsageRecord is created in the database.
Verify the UsageSummary for the current month is updated: tokensUsed increases by the reported quantity.
Call with usageType FILE_UPLOADED and verify storageUsedMb and filesCount increase in UsageSummary.
Call with usageType CHATBOT_CREATED and verify chatbotCount increases.
Call with usageType FILE_DELETED and verify storageUsedMb and filesCount decrease.

features.title: Check usage limit before processing
features.user_visible_behavior: When a user's usage reaches the plan limit, further actions are blocked with an appropriate error until they upgrade.
verification: Call POST /internal/usage/check with subscriptionId and usageType TOKEN_USED.
Verify response returns allowed: true when usage is below the plan limit.
Simulate tokensUsed reaching maxMonthlyTokens and call again.
Verify response returns allowed: false with reason TOKEN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
Verify the same behavior for STORAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and CHATBOT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

features.title: Get current month usage summary
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can view how much of their plan quota has been used in the current billing period.
verification: Call GET /api/v1/usage/summary.
Verify response includes tokensUsed, storageUsedMb, chatbotCount, filesCount, and apiCalls.
Verify each metric is shown alongside the plan limit for comparison.
Verify the summary reflects the current billing month, not the calendar month.

features.title: Get usage history by month
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can view past monthly usage summaries to understand their consumption over time.
verification: Call GET /api/v1/usage/history.
Verify response includes one UsageSummary per past billing period.
Verify summaries are sorted by year and month descending.
Verify each entry includes year, month, tokensUsed, storageUsedMb, chatbotCount, and filesCount.

features.title: Auto-renew subscription at end of period
features.user_visible_behavior: When a subscription period ends and autoRenew is enabled, a new order and invoice are created automatically and the period is extended.
verification: Set a subscription's currentPeriodEnd to a past timestamp with autoRenew true.
Trigger the renewal job.
Verify a new Order is created with orderType RENEWAL.
Verify a new Invoice is created linked to the renewal order.
Verify currentPeriodStart and currentPeriodEnd are advanced by one billing cycle.
Verify a new UsageSummary is created for the new period with all counters reset to zero.
Verify subscriptions with autoRenew false are not renewed and their status changes to EXPIRED.

features.title: Expire subscription when autoRenew is off
features.user_visible_behavior: When a subscription ends without autoRenew, its status changes to EXPIRED and the user loses access to paid features.
verification: Set a subscription's currentPeriodEnd to a past timestamp with autoRenew false.
Trigger the expiry job.
Verify subscription status changes to EXPIRED.
Call POST /internal/usage/check for the expired subscription.
Verify it returns allowed: false with reason SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED.
